title: Mock Test Platform | Aura Learn
meta: Mock test platform for coaching and exam prep: build timed tests from a question bank, grade on submission, show instant scores with review, track every learner.
h1: A mock test platform that grades the paper the moment the learner submits.
sub: Aura Learn lets you build full-length timed mock tests from your own question bank, release them to a batch, grade them on submission and hand each learner an instant score with a question-by-question review, with analytics per learner and per batch on the dashboard.

sections.h2: What a mock test platform does here
paras: A mock test platform lets an institute build timed, exam-pattern tests from a question bank, deliver them to learners in an app, grade them automatically and show every learner where they went wrong. In Aura Learn this is the assessment layer of the same platform that holds your courses, batches and fees, so a test series is not a separate subscription.

Faculty write or import questions once, tag them by subject and topic, and assemble a paper with a time limit and a release window. Learners sit the test in the mobile app, see their score on submission, and open a review that shows each question, their answer and the correct one. The dashboard records the attempt per learner and rolls scores up per batch.

sections.h2: A weekly test series is the hardest thing to keep running by hand.
sections.lead: Setting the paper, printing it, marking it and returning it takes the whole week, and the learner gets feedback after the topic has moved on.

items.p: Faculty spend Sunday evening checking answer sheets instead of preparing Monday's class.
By the time the score is returned, the learner cannot remember why they picked the wrong option.
The same questions go into next year's tests because nobody knows which ones were already used.
Faculty cannot see which topic the whole batch is failing without adding up marks by hand.

items.a: Yes. Each mock test has a time limit and a release window for the batch. The app submits the attempt automatically when time runs out, and the score is shown straight away.

Objective questions are graded automatically on submission against the answer key in the question bank. Learners then open a review that shows each question, their answer, the correct answer and any explanation you stored.

items.q: Can we reuse questions across tests?
items.a: Yes. Questions live in a tagged bank and can be pulled into any quiz or mock test, and the bank records where each question has been used. See question bank software for how the bank is organised.

Score per attempt and the trend per learner, plus topic-wise results per batch, so you can see which topics the batch is losing marks on and plan revision accordingly. Attempt and completion are tracked too, so you know who skipped the test.

items.q: Can learners take a mock test on their phone?
items.a: Yes. Tests are attempted in the learner mobile app, which is the same app that holds their lessons, timetable and notices. Lessons can be downloaded for offline study; a timed test needs a connection to submit.

items.q: Is this proven on a real exam-prep product?
items.a: Yes. Elevate Aura's own government-exam-prep app runs on the same stack, is live on Google Play and uses Telegram practice bots for daily questions. See the exam-prep app case study for what was built.
